fundamentals.name: Hims & Hers Health, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Hims & Hers Health, Inc. operates as a consumer-first health and wellness platform that connects consumers to licensed healthcare professionals in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, the Republic of Ireland, France, Spain, and internationally. The company offers a range of curated prescription and non-prescription health and wellness products and services available to purchase on its websites and mobile application directly by customers. It also provides personalized health and wellness products; over-the-counter drug and device products, cosmetics, and supplement products primarily focusing on general wellness, skincare, sexual health and wellness, and hair care under the Hims & Hers brand name; and laboratory testing services to measure a set of biomarkers. Additionally, it offers medical consultation, post-consultation support services, and delivery of laboratory testing results services. Further, the company provides treatments and products for various chronic conditions related to hormone health, weight loss, dermatology, and mental health. The company offers its products through retail partnerships, in stores, and online. Hims & Hers Health, Inc. is based in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: A company with strong gross margins and free cash flow but burdened by negative operating margins, high debt, and declining analyst growth estimates.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter EPS missed estimate by a wide margin; next earnings date is 2026-08-10.
positives: Gross margin 72.9% — indicates strong pricing power on services.
Free cash flow (TTM) $174.31M — positive cash generation.
Total cash $750.88M — provides some liquidity cushion.
negatives: Operating margin -7.9% and Profit margin -0.6% — the core business is not profitable.
Analyst growth est, current Q -55.1% and current FY -15.3% — significant expected revenue contraction.
Last quarter EPS actual -0.40 vs estimate 0.03 — a massive earnings miss.

news.paragraph: Hims & Hers has seen a flurry of analyst articles questioning its stock valuation and future growth prospects, with recent reports highlighting a significant miss on last quarter's EPS and a projected decline in current quarter and fiscal year earnings. Despite a strong gross margin and positive free cash flow, the company's operating and profit margins are negative, and its debt-to-equity ratio is high, raising concerns about its financial health and the sustainability of its current valuation. The stock has edged higher in recent days, but the overall sentiment from the news flow points to uncertainty regarding its future performance.
